_note: eASLRB v3.14 U.S. vehicle listing (PDF pages 377-378, 0-based 377-378): the embedded TrueType subsets carry no cmap/ToUnicode, so extraction yields raw codes. Codes are assigned in Windows-1252 order of each subset's character set, so each entry is that set in code order (code i = character i). Built from rendered glyph sheets, 2026-11-01. NUL = an unidentified blank glyph that sorts first. NBSP = a second blank glyph that sorts last.
